title: Nebius announces approximately USD 775 million senior secured debt facility
publisher: Nebius Group N.V. via the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Nebius announced an approximately USD 775 million senior secured facility due October 31, 2030 at SOFR plus 2.50%, backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows; it cited more than USD 40 billion of additional contracted revenue.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release provides current evidence on asset-backed financing, customer-contract coverage of underlying deployment capex, delivery progress, funding cost, and the scale and concentration of contracted revenue.
